import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset from the provided string
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,transfer,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set a professional seaborn style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a figure with a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Overview (Sample)', fontsize=18, y=0.98)

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount
sns.histplot(df['amount'], kde=True, ax=axes[0, 0], bins=len(df['amount'].unique()), alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)

# Plot 2: Count of Transaction Types
sns.countplot(y='transaction_type', data=df, ax=axes[0, 1], order=df['transaction_type'].value_counts().index)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Count of Transaction Types', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)

# Plot 3: Distribution of Hour of Day
# Use discrete=True for hour_of_day as it's an integer
sns.histplot(df['hour_of_day'], ax=axes[1, 0], discrete=True, stat='count', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
# Ensure all unique hours are shown as x-ticks
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(sorted(df['hour_of_day'].unique()))

# Plot 4: Amount vs. Hour of Day, colored by Transaction Type
# Note: 'is_fraud' is constant (0) in the provided sample, so using 'transaction_type' for hue
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', s=150, ax=axes[1, 1], style='transaction_type')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Amount vs. Hour of Day by Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Amount', fontsize=12)
# Ensure all unique hours are shown as x-ticks
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(sorted(df['hour_of_day'].unique()))
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Transaction Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles and labels
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
